rationale: The plan uses pydeseq2 Wald on ~condition for the unpaired 6v6 single-batch design, honoring the Python constraint with no R anywhere, and explicitly sets control as the denominator with the sign convention written out. QC precedes the fit with library sizes, detected genes, blind VST PCA colored by condition, a distance heatmap, and an explicit keep-inspect-report policy for the shallow sample_01 plus a sensitivity re-fit — exactly the reference behavior. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified by the smallest group size, only mildly stricter than a bare minimum; normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model with an explicit prohibition on pre-scaling. FDR is BH at a stated alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage retained alongside unshrunken estimates, Cook's NA accounting separated, and lfcThreshold named as the in-model route for effect-size questions. Enrichment is gseapy prerank on the full tested list ranked by the Wald statistic with the rationale stated, local human hallmark 2026.1 GMT, 15-500 window applied after intersection, fixed seed, and redundancy collapsing; the report section names methods, versions, design, thresholds, counts and design caveats. The voom-style second method is a slight stretch since a hand-assembled empirical-Bayes fit is not truly limma, but the plan pre-commits to declaring failure rather than faking it, so it does not damage the scored criteria.
